facts.fact: Devan wore the brass post-key on a cord at his own neck since taking it from Muthu (ch 9 of book 2), and returns it to Muthu in the gate chamber over the padippura, asking him to bring anything he cannot carry to Devan first.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Devan return the post-key to Muthu.

facts.fact: Eravi asks leave to ride up the wood road to 'a tapper I know' for willow bark and poppy, leaving at first light with Sankaran as escort as far as the ford, back in two days; his cuff smells of the green salve. Devan does not ask the tapper's name.
facts.why: needed because the beat plants clue C18 through Eravi's request.

facts.fact: Devan's patrol order sends six men under Corporal Kandan to walk the lower narrows to the shelf and back before dark, to find who the scouts' mirror signalled; Kandan's men initially refuse, then go.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Kandan's faction refuse a patrol order.

facts.fact: Devan reaches Kettamala at noon after riding through the night, and the assize sits at lamp-lighting that day. He leaves on the grey mare after the welt opens. Rema counts three 'I won't answer that' answers that day and notes Neela's absence from the witness bench.
facts.why: needed to place the assize and Rema's warning in time.
